outcome: Record review follow-ups of closed outcomes as linked outcomes: begin --follows names the closed outcomes a new outcome follows up, and log shows the thread, while closed outcomes stay final and untouched
criteria: inkan begin --follows <id>, repeatable, records each named closed outcome in the new outcome's begin event and leaves every followed outcome's file byte-for-byte unchanged
begin --follows refuses a malformed, unknown, or still-open outcome id and writes no outcome file
inkan log prints follows <id> on a follow-up's line, and inkan status and inkan log <id> print each directly followed outcome with its status, or missing when its file is absent
inkan log <id> prints the thread: every outcome the record follows and every outcome that follows it, directly or transitively, in chronological order with status and headline
The follow link is excluded from the contract hash, so existing records keep their hashes and Inkan 0.7.0 still reads a record that carries the link

Protocol 14 rule 5, in repo and local modes, says that when review of closed work asks for changes, the new outcome's inkan begin names the closed outcome it follows; init upgrades generated protocols 1 through 13 to 14, keeps local mode, and still refuses hand-edited blocks; this repository's AGENTS.md is regenerated
inkan help, README.md, and README.zh.md document begin --follows and the thread in log <id>

A new decision record, with outcome follow-up links as its subject, records begin --follows and rejects reopening a closed outcome and holding an outcome open through review; decision 0008 history records protocol 14

dispositions.note: verified by running the installed 0.7.0 log, log <id>, status, and doctor against records written with --follows

note: begin --follows links a follow-up to closed outcomes without writing to them; log marks follow-ups, status and log <id> name the followed outcomes, and log <id> prints the thread in sealed order, not id order, because ids within one minute sort by their random suffix. Protocol 14 carries the rule 5 sentence, decision 0020 records the choice over reopening or holding outcomes open, and 0008 history records the bump. npm test passes 122 tests; bench stays within the 0009 targets.
